title: LongBanana: An Expert-Verified Benchmark for Long-Context Multi-Reference Image Synthesis
snippet: LongBanana contains 90 carefully designed tasks organized by a 3-by-3 taxonomy; each task includes about 32 reference images, 20 constraints, and 50 evaluation items, yielding 4,670 expert-specified atomic evaluation items in total.
